memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The fear and dread of you will fall on all the beasts of the earth... Everything that lives and moves about will be food for you. Just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you everything. But you must not eat meat that has its lifeblood still in it." - Gen 9:2-4 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As Noah begins again, God graciously expands His provision. Where humanity had been given plants to eat, now God gives "everything" - meat is added to His generous supply for human need. God is a giver, providing abundantly for the people He has made. Every good thing on our table ultimately comes from His open hand.

But notice that provision comes with responsibility. God adds a boundary: they must not eat meat with its lifeblood still in it. Blood, throughout Scripture, represents life, and life is sacred to God. Even in granting freedom to eat, God teaches Noah to hold life as holy and to receive His gifts with reverence, not carelessness.

This is a pattern we see all through the Bible. God's gifts are generous, but they are never meant to be used thoughtlessly. Freedom in God's world always comes with reverence for God's ways. He gives us much to enjoy, and asks us to enjoy it His way, honouring Him in how we receive it.

For us who live after the cross, the deeper truth shines brighter still: life is in the blood, and it was the shed blood of Jesus that purchased our life (Eph 1:7). Every meal, every provision, every gift is a reminder of the God who provides - and supremely, of the One who gave His own lifeblood for us. Receive God's gifts today with gratitude and reverence.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you receive God's daily provision with gratitude and reverence?
- Are you enjoying God's gifts His way, honouring Him in how you use them?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Generous God, thank You for providing so richly for my needs. Teach me to receive Your gifts with gratitude and reverence, holding life sacred, and thank You for the blood of Jesus that purchased my life.
